prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Job hunt". Read it with fetch before each change. When I paste a job ad or a link, add a row to the table with edit: Company, Role (as a link to the ad if I gave one), Stage Saved, and the Next step. When I tell you I applied or heard back, update that row's Stage and Next step. Before an interview, add five likely questions and my talking points under "Interview prep", under a "###" heading with the company name. When I ask what's next, list the follow-ups under "This week" as a checklist.

asks: Ask me for the job ad I want to save, then add it to the table with its next step.
